digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolution
propositions: rebar lacks a way to express which model corresponds to which capability tier (frontier, standard, trivial) and currently uses a single scalar cfg.model for all per-pass decisions

the schema must support three configuration slots (trivial, standard, frontier) with fields for model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array, parsed from layered config (CLI > env > file > default) but not yet consumed at runtime
environment variables must address nested slot fields individually (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, etc.) to preserve per-key precedence rules rather than inventing a merge rule for whole objects
fallback entries must validate to the slot schema minus the fallback field itself, must forbid api_key, must not nest recursively, and must be parsed and carried but not yet consumed at runtime
secrets must remain env-only; config files must not accept api_key in slots or fallback entries, mirroring the existing rule that secrets are not config-file keys
an unset slot must resolve to its class default (frontier->claude-opus-4-8, standard->claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial->claude-haiku-4-5) ensuring byte-identical behavior when nothing is configured
